scope: Historical MerLin local simulations; financial ECB adaptation and Belenos-characteristic controls, no QPU results
history_schema_normalization: The frozen financial campaign predates generic loss names: finite_shot_tvd/exact_lossless_tvd are mapped to the explicitly labeled TVD columns on export only. Raw artifacts are unchanged; all 60 final TVD values were recomputed from probabilities.

shot_accounting.scope: Per-run committed call counts include inherited prefixes. Original/retry physical ledgers must be counted separately; see TRAINING.md for replay and unknown-interruption costs.

metric: Finite-shot KL(model||target), log2, for Gaussian/Belenos; finite-shot TVD for financial. Exact lossless-at-same-I is diagnostic only.

recording.band: mean +/- population SD, lower bound clipped at zero; not SEM or CI

b.selection: Five lowest final finite-shot KL separately per condition; seed is the stable tie-break. Reproduction choice: author criterion unpublished.
b.display: ten learning curves, not a histogram

d.subsampling: multivariate hypergeometric without replacement from stored counts; no new photonic draws
d.binning_scope: Visualization choice; original paper financial provider/dates/bin edges unavailable

e.selection: Fixed seed identifiers independent of performance
e.display: three individual curves per condition, no band or failed partial dashed curve
e.deviation: Different initializations; paper experimental repeats used one common initialization

f.selection: Best original noisy recycling I=.729 final finite-shot KL among 19 complete originals; same seed for all added controls, retries excluded
f.scope: Six simulated controls; a single selected seed, not a population comparison

data_sources.gaussian: Known discrete Gaussian mixture, means141/353,std61/61,495 bins

financial.transformation: Successive-available natural-log returns and histogram calculated by reproduction authors; not ECB-produced derived data

limitations: No original author numerical runs or financial raw observations supplied
I=.84 is a model choice; HOM measurement definition is not confirmed equivalent
Original failures and separate sampling retries remain distinct
Attribution/permission and live ECB acquisition limits remain in DATA_SOURCES.md

combined_layout.scope: Same plot artists and historical values as the three panel-pair exports; no new sampling or training
